about: Named generation recipes for mw.py gen. 'params' are defaults; override with --cfg/--steps/--sampler/--scheduler/--shift/--planner or --set '{json}'. Each recipe says where its numbers came from. Add a recipe only after a run that a listener judged.

acestep-xl-sft.use: default for instrumentals 30 s to 4 min: game beds, themes, solos, film movements
acestep-xl-sft.timing: about 80-100 s per 180 s track on a 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti once loaded; peaks about 12.9 GB VRAM
acestep-xl-sft.source: listener-approved batches (bright melodic electronica with flute leads, 2026-08); cfg 7 sounded harsh to that listener, cfg 4.5 did not. The 1.7B planner sits beside the 10 GB DiT on 16 GB far better than the 4B one.

acestep-xl-sft-pack.needs_pack: the ComfyUI-AceStep_SFT custom nodes (MIT; audited at commit 3e802ea)
acestep-xl-sft-pack.use: second opinion on an instrumental, or when acestep-xl-sft fades out before the asked length. Text to music only; no cover or repaint.
acestep-xl-sft-pack.timing: about 40-45 s per 60 s take on a 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti once loaded
acestep-xl-sft-pack.source: one listener, blind pairs against acestep-xl-sft, two seeds of one flute caption, 2026-11-06: preferred this clearly once and slightly once. Not the default: the sample is small, the pack was always side B, and these takes end without a fade.

acestep-xl-sft-classic.use: the ComfyUI template defaults; firmer adherence, harsher top end. Try when 4.5 drifts off the caption.
acestep-xl-sft-classic.timing: 10-minute tracks take about 9.5-10 minutes on a 16 GB card
acestep-xl-sft-classic.source: ComfyUI's ACE-Step 1.5 XL template; used for long-form and short film cues 2026-08 to 2026-10

acestep-xl-base.use: extract one part (--task extract --track) inside ComfyUI; base is the only 1.5 checkpoint trained for extract
acestep-xl-base.timing: 30 s source: 45 s cold, 15 s warm on a 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti
acestep-xl-base.source: Comfy-Org/ACE-Step-1.5 split_files; extract nodes vendored from ComfyUI_RyanOnTheInside (research 06, 2026-11-03). A listener rated drums and vocals taken from one punk mix as mostly that part alone, 2026-11-03 (seed 4002); a cymbal or synth sound near the end of the drums was left undecided

minimax-music3.model: MiniMax Music 3 (open weights, MiniMax-Music3 Community License: free commercial use under USD 20M yearly revenue, show 'MiniMax-Music3' in the product, disclose AI output)
minimax-music3.use: second opinion for songs and long instrumentals; caption as three headings (Global Metadata, Vocal Details, Arrangement with a minute timeline)
minimax-music3.timing: 3-7 min per take typical; takes came back shorter than asked (98-170 s for 180-195 s); one 240 s beatless request hung over an hour. Use --timeout and render longer than needed; 2026-11-02 on the 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti: 60 s asked -> 43 s in 105 s, 90 s asked -> 63 s in 140 s (about 0.7 of the request), peak 15.3 GB VRAM. Ask for about 1.4x the length you need.
minimax-music3.source: ComfyUI audio_minimax_music_3 template. Kept by a listener 2026-11-03: two instrumental takes (calm fantasy theme, flute over strings, D major, 90 bpm, seeds 3101 and 3102); the verdict covered the pair. Blind pair 2026-11-04, one listener: seed 3101 preferred, the reference take

stable-audio3-medium.model: Stable Audio 3 Medium (open weights, Stability Community Licence: free under USD 1M revenue, you own outputs)
stable-audio3-medium.use: very fast instrumental drafts and beds with no vocals; give tempo and key in the caption
stable-audio3-medium.timing: 60 s in 9 s on a 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti; returned exactly the asked length
stable-audio3-medium.source: ComfyUI bundled template. Kept by a listener 2026-11-03: one take, calm ambient space theme, seed 3301. Second take through mw.py gen, seed 4101, same brief, 2026-11-04: not bad but slightly too intense, not calm or ambient, so it can miss a calm brief: fish seeds or tighten the caption

yue2-3b-int8.model: YuE2-3B int8 (CC BY-NC 4.0 weights plus creator permission: individuals may sell outputs, companies need a licence)
yue2-3b-int8.use: lyrics-led songs; plans an ABC score, saved beside the take as .abc. Needs --lyrics, --lyrics-file or --sections; the caption is the style
yue2-3b-int8.timing: 90 s asked, 78 s returned in 33 s, about 8.5 GB VRAM on a 16 GB card; peaks reached +0.1 dBTP, so master before use
yue2-3b-int8.source: ComfyUI bundled template. Kept by a listener 2026-11-03: one take, a folk ballad with lyrics, seed 3401. Second take through mw.py gen, seed 4102, also kept 2026-11-04. Melody cover (--task cover): one listener said the tune carries over and it sounds good, better of two takes, seeds 4301 and 4302, 2026-11-06; the requested female vocal was barely audible

acestep-rest.model: ACE-Step 1.5 2B turbo + 5Hz LM planner through the ACE-Step REST server (MIT)
acestep-rest.use: fast drafts (a 60 s take in about 22 s once warm) and the source tasks without custom nodes: cover, repaint, extend, extract (ComfyUI needs the plugin's comfy_nodes for repaint and extract)
acestep-rest.timing: 60 s -> 22 s, 120 s -> 31 s warm; the first request after server start loads models for about 2.5 min (submit timeout 900 s)
acestep-rest.source: measured 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-12 on a 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti; rechecked 2026-11-02 through mw.py gen: text2music 30 s in 3 min 10 s cold, cover, repaint and extract about 9 s each warm (repaint left audio outside the window bit-identical)

acestep-rest-lego.model: ACE-Step 1.5 2B base through the ACE-Step REST server (MIT); start the server with ACESTEP_CONFIG_PATH=acestep-v15-base
acestep-rest-lego.use: add one part to a kept take: --task lego --src LEAD --track woodwinds (or another part); duck it under the lead with duck --stem for call and response
acestep-rest-lego.timing: 16-25 s per 60 s take on a 16 GB card, peak 7.5 GB; mw.py sends 50 steps and dcw_enabled false
acestep-rest-lego.source: kept by a listener 2026-10-18: a second, jazzier flute (seed 8101, bpm 66 and D minor in the metadata, 50 steps, DCW off) over a free-time solo flute; both the plain mix and the mix with the part ducked under the lead (ratio 3, threshold 0.02, attack 80 ms, release 700 ms) were kept, the ducked one best
